metadata.title: Recent company-list evidence for the 152-question study tracker
metadata.snapshotDateBasis: Pinned commit message: Update Problem [Oct 20]; commit timestamp is October 21, 2026. The repository README and description retain older dates.
metadata.recencyCaveat: The source provides rolling six-month company lists, not individual interview or report timestamps. This is a snapshot ending around October 20, not a continuously updated window ending today.
metadata.sampleDesign: A fixed, deliberately varied set of 25 named technology, finance and enterprise employers, chosen before examining tracked-question matches. Each company list counts once; TikTok is the sole ByteDance-family representative.
metadata.roleScope: The source does not expose role, level, location or interview stage. Software-engineering-only eligibility cannot be verified.
metadata.questionScope: Only the 150 canonical NeetCode tracker slugs and two Binary Search extras are retained. Explicit Database-tagged rows are excluded from the within-company ranking universe. No problem statements or solutions are copied.
metadata.sourceFrequencyMeaning: The source's Frequency field is a relative 0–100 value whose normalization and underlying report counts are undocumented. It is used only for ranking questions within the same company's six-month list; it is not an interview probability.
metadata.withinCompanyPercentileMethod: 100 × (number of eligible distinct questions with lower Frequency + 0.5 × number with equal Frequency) / number with a valid Frequency, rounded to two decimals. Ties receive the same midpoint percentile; a one-question list receives 50.
metadata.meanWithinCompanyPercentileMethod: Arithmetic mean across only company lists in which the tracked question appears and has a valid Frequency. Nonappearance is missing evidence, not a zero percentile.
metadata.coverageMeaning: companyCount counts appearances in these selected company lists. It is neither a count of interview reports nor a percentage chance of an interview question.
metadata.missingEvidenceMeaning: Zero companyCount means no matching slug was found in the selected available lists. It does not mean the question was never asked or has zero study value.
metadata.sourceDataLicense: No explicit LICENSE file is present at the pinned repository root; the dataset's reuse license is not specified there.
metadata.originalCompanyTagMethodology: LeetCode states that company question lists are compiled from user surveys about questions seen in real interviews.
metadata.excludedSourceColumnsReason: Acceptance Rate is unrelated to interview prevalence and appears to use an inconsistent scale in this snapshot.

requestedCompaniesUnavailable.name: Dropbox
requestedCompaniesUnavailable.reason: The pinned six-month CSV is header-only; no question records are available.

excludedRelatedCompanyLists.name: ByteDance
excludedRelatedCompanyLists.reason: Only one list from the ByteDance/TikTok corporate family is counted. TikTok has the fuller six-month list.

limitations: This is a community company-tag snapshot, not employer-verified or randomly sampled interview data.
Company coverage is unequal; 12 of the 25 selected lists contain fewer than 10 eligible questions.
No underlying report counts or sampling denominators are available, so no statistical confidence intervals or interview probabilities are calculated.
Question identities are matched by canonical LeetCode URL slug. An unmatched slug may reflect missing reports, source coverage or naming changes.
Repeated or related questions can span topics. Topic membership comes from the tracker rather than being inferred from these company counts.
Study-relevance scores must combine this limited recent evidence with transferable pattern value and broader preparation evidence; absence must not automatically suppress a question.
